defects.title: alphasage._unroll looks up a FeatureToken for a daily leaf, so the WP10 vocabulary crashes the AlphaSAGE miner
defects.failure_scenario: WP4 added a DailyFeature branch to _unroll whose comment anticipates that WP10 would give daily fields a FeatureToken ("Same token family as a minute Feature -- vocab carries no daily tokens until WP10 adds them"). WP10 instead introduced a separate DailyFeatureToken type, and nothing reconciled the two, so a WP10 vocabulary never contains FeatureToken('FloatCap'). GFlowNetSampler.sample calls build_partial_tree_graph(b.stack, vocab) at the top of EVERY step (alphasage.py:138), so the first time the policy draws a daily token the next iteration dies: reproduced end to end in /Users/wxy/Desktop/Partura/tmp/impl/review_WP10/attack3.py -- Vocabulary(reg, daily_fields=('FloatCap',)), a ForwardPolicy biased toward the daily token, sampler.sample(greedy=True) -> KeyError: "token FeatureToken(field='FloatCap') is not in the vocabulary". The daily token is offered unconditionally at every operand position, so for `--miner alphasage` (pipeline.MINERS line 16) this is a certainty in the first episode, not an edge case. The suite is green on this because tests/test_daily_leaf_engine.py:462 test_alphasage_unroll_resolves_once_a_vocabulary_carries_the_token builds Vocabulary(registry, fields=list(registry.fields) + ['FloatCap']) -- a vocabulary shape WP10 does not and cannot produce -- so the one test written to cover "however WP10 arranges for that" now asserts nothing about the real path.
defects.suggested_fix: In alphasage.py import DailyFeatureToken from .tokens and make the DailyFeature branch `nodes.append(vocab.index_of(DailyFeatureToken(expr.field)))`; drop the now-wrong comment. Then change tests/test_daily_leaf_engine.py:462's fixture to Vocabulary(registry, daily_fields=['FloatCap']) and assert nodes[idx] == vocab.index_of(DailyFeatureToken('FloatCap')) (the sibling test at :447, which only requires a KeyError naming FloatCap on a daily-free vocabulary, keeps passing either way). Both files are WP4-owned, so this needs a WP4 follow-up commit or an ownership grant; alternatively tokens.py can export a leaf->token helper, but the alphasage call site still has to change.

defects.title: operator_logit_bias turns a non-finite op_weight into a NaN/inf bias instead of rejecting it
defects.failure_scenario: math.log(max(w, tiny)) only floors the LOW end. In Python max(float('nan'), 1e-9) is nan (max returns the first argument unless the second compares greater), so a weight of NaN writes nan into the bias array, and +inf writes inf; measured in /Users/wxy/Desktop/Partura/tmp/impl/review_WP10/attack1.py (bias=nan, any_nan=True). Added to a policy's logits, one NaN poisons the whole row: torch.distributions.Categorical(logits=...) raises ValueError('Expected parameter logits ... to satisfy the constraint Real()') at the first sampling step, naming no operator and no field. A data-driven op_weight is the expected caller (Partura's steer arm derives weights from research output), and a mean over an empty group yields NaN. The same callable on the GP side behaves differently rather than failing: generator._pick_weighted does max(0.0, float(op_weight(s))) then `if w > 0.0`, so NaN silently becomes 0.0 and the operator is simply dropped (verified: max(0.0, nan) == 0.0). So the design's "one shared op_weight then steers both searches" (WP10 step 5) gives one arm a silent drop and the other an opaque crash, and generator._check_weight's own docstring says this guard exists so that "a NaN from some upstream computation" fails with the cause named -- WP10 re-consumes weights without it.
defects.suggested_fix: After w = float(op_weight(spec)), validate the same bound _check_weight validates: `if not math.isfinite(w) or w < 0.0: raise ValueError(f"op_weight for {spec.name!r} must be a finite float >= 0, got {w!r}")` (dropping the negative case is also defensible since the existing test pins -5.0 flooring to log(tiny), but non-finite must not pass through). Add a test asserting a NaN-returning op_weight raises with the operator name in the message.

defects.title: A duplicate name in daily_fields makes vocab.size smaller than the largest live token index
defects.failure_scenario: daily_fields is stored raw (list(daily_fields)) and the tokens are appended one per entry, so a repeated name collapses in token_to_index (last index wins) and leaves a hole: Vocabulary(reg, daily_fields=('FloatCap','FloatCap')) gives size 244 while max(index_to_token) is 244 and index 243 is missing (measured, attack1.py). Because the daily group sits at the TAIL, the live index exceeds size and TokenEnv(vocab).reset() raises `IndexError: index 244 is out of bounds for axis 0 with size 244` inside action_mask (env.py:76) before a single step runs; operator_logit_bias likewise returns an array one slot too short to index. The pre-existing duplicate hazard on `fields` produces the same hole but is latent, because those indices are not at the tail (verified: Vocabulary(reg, fields=['Close','Close','Ret']) builds a hole at index 2 and TokenEnv.reset() still works), so the new parameter converts a dormant hazard into an immediate crash. Reachable from a caller, not from a default: SearchHooks.daily_fields (plugins.py:53) is a caller-assembled tuple that nothing validates on any path, so a plugin concatenating two field lists hits it.
defects.suggested_fix: Dedupe order-preservingly in __init__: `self.daily_fields = list(dict.fromkeys(daily_fields))`, or raise ValueError naming the repeated name. Same one-liner is worth applying to self.fields and self.constants. Add a test asserting Vocabulary(reg, daily_fields=('FloatCap','FloatCap')).size == base.size + 1 and that TokenEnv over it resets cleanly.

result.notes:
WP10 审查结论:owned 文件内的实现本身干净且向后兼容是实测过硬的,但它选的新 token 类型和已落地的 WP4 对不上,导致 alphasage 这条 RL 线一开就崩 —— 这是唯一的 high。

实测过的东西(脚本都在 /Users/wxy/Desktop/Partura/tmp/impl/review_WP10/,未改任何已跟踪文件、未提交):
- 向后兼容(a/b 两条都查了,结论是真的):dump_vocab.py 把基线树 /Users/wxy/Desktop/AlphaCube(517fd09)和本 worktree 的 Vocabulary(default_registry()) 全量 token 序列做 sha256 对比 —— 243 个 token、214 个算子、hash 完全相同(f2fb1d01…)。rollout.py 进一步用同一个 random.Random(1234) 在两棵树上跑 3000 条 valid_next_tokens 随机漫步 + 500 步 TokenEnv,把每一步"有序的" valid 列表、mask 位数、reward、done、完成表达式 key 全进 trace 哈希 —— 两树一致(1cc872d6…)。默认参数下 daily 分支确实不进(daily_fields 为空 → 列表推导产出空列表,append 顺序不变),tokens.py 里本来就没有随机数,operator_logit_bias 目前无调用者,所以随机流不可能动。
- 新代码路径对不对(c):attack4.py 穷举了语法在"裸 daily 叶子"上提供的全部 444 个单算子组合,其中 441 个是合法 root,全部在带 daily store 的 synthetic view 上成功求值,0 失败;attack5.py 再做随机漫步 fuzz,收集 400 条含 DF 叶子的完整表达式(含 2 个 daily 字段、分批 + 单条回退定位),同样 0 失败。所以"push 时不再做 operand 检查、交给静态 shape 系统"这个判断在引擎侧站得住,我没能攻破。另外确认 registry.searchable() 里没有重名 OpSpec(test_tokens_env.py:25 的 size 公式通过即证),所以 operator_logit_bias 的 index_of 不会重复写同一格。
- 测试真假(d):逐条做了变异推演。删掉 DailyFeatureToken 追加行 / 把它挪到算子组之前 / push 里换成 Feature(field) / 去掉 unknown-field 守卫 / 把 log(max(w,tiny)) 写成 log(w+tiny),这五种写错法都会让 test_daily_tokens.py 变红(最后一种会因为 pytest.approx(0.0) 的 1e-12 绝对容差而红)。两处弱的地方不构成缺陷:test_operator_logit_bias_masks_a_zeroed_operator 里 probs[0] < 1e-6 和 20000 次抽样"从不抽到"是从 bias 自己算出来的,属于同义反复,真正有效的断言是那两行 bias[...] == approx(math.log(tiny));argmax 那行也偏弱。设计要求的"手写期望映射"用的是缩小的 fields/constants/windows 并复用了被测对象的 vocab.operators 排序,算子排序是 WP10 之前就有的行为,可以接受(而且我上面用基线树做了更强的全量对比)。
- 文件范围(e):git show --name-only 只有 src/alphacube/mining/tokens.py 和 tests/test_daily_tokens.py;git status --porcelain 干净;分支 partura-steering;提交信息末行是 Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>。没碰清单外文件。
- 全套测试:917 passed, 10 skipped, 1 xfailed(无失败;基线 617 是前几个包之前的数,期间 WP1–WP8 加了测试)。

实现者自报 deviations 为空,我核过一处"判断调用"并认为可以接受:operator_logit_bias 只收已解析的 callable、不收 {name: weight} 原始映射。plugins.SearchHooks.op_weight 的类型就是 Optional[Callable[[OpSpec], float]](plugins.py:51),插件这条路本来就只传 callable,所以"一个 op_weight 同时steer两边"在实际接口上成立,不算与设计冲突。

设计层面的衔接缺口(不是 WP10 的实现错误,但协调者必须另行排包,否则 WP10 是死代码):pipeline.py:398 的 RL 分支建 Vocabulary 时没有传 daily_fields,也没有任何 miner 调用 operator_logit_bias —— 设计 §6(第 407 行)说"the miners derive logit_bias[i] … added to the policy logits before action_mask",但 WP10 的 owned 文件不含 pipeline.py 和四个 miner 文件,别的工作包也没有把这块划给谁。现状是:机制齐了,但从 CLI/pipeline 走不到,必须有后续改动把 hooks.daily_fields 透给 Vocabulary、并在 alphagen/alphaqcm/alphaforge/alphasage 的采样处把 bias 加到 logits 上。顺带一提,上面的 high 缺陷正好是这块接线一通就立刻会踩到的第一颗雷,建议把两件事放同一个后续包。

另一个无害的观察(不计缺陷):tests/test_tokens_env.py:25 的 vocab.size == 2 + fields + operators + constants + windows 公式没算 daily_fields,只因为该测试自己建的是默认 vocab 才仍然通过;哪天有人在那里加 daily 字段会误伤。
